# Explore bridge cross-sections

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-viewer-examples.js. -->

Move a section cut along a bridge alignment to inspect the structure at different distances along the route.

## How it works

<h3>Try it</h3><ol><li>Open Sections (scissors) on the left toolbar and click Bridge under Alignments.</li><li>Enable Cross-section at station, then enter a distance in Station / KP (m) to move the cut along the bridge. KP is distance along the alignment.</li><li>Use Next station or enter another distance to compare cross-sections.</li></ol><h2>Developer integration</h2><p>Pass the published bridge sample to <code>viewer.add()</code>. Alignment navigation and KP sections are SDK controls; the host does not implement route navigation.</p><p>Copy this folder and serve it over HTTP, for example <code>python -m http.server 8080</code>. Open <code>http://localhost:8080/</code>; the SDK and sample downloads require internet access.</p>
